item.title: Search
item.description:
For Viewers & Installers

Roles: Viewer, Installer, Designer, Manager

The Search feature is your primary tool for finding specific devices quickly.

Accessing Search

From the sidebar, tap Search under the Inventory section.

Search Methods

Text Search

  1. Tap the search text field
  2. Enter your search term:
    • Device name
    • Customer Label ID
    • Serial number
    • Wirepas Node ID
    • External ID
  3. Tap Search or press Return

The search will find devices matching your query across multiple identifier fields.

item.title: Device Installation
item.description:
For Designers & Managers

Roles: Installer, Designer, Manager

Install devices by positioning them on floor plans.

Accessing Device Installation

From the sidebar, tap Devices under the Setup section.

Selecting a Floor

  1. Browse the list of available floors
  2. Each floor shows:
    • Thumbnail: Preview of the floor plan
    • Site name: The parent site
    • Building / Floor: Building and floor names
  3. Tap a floor to open the installation map

Installing Devices on the Floor Plan

  1. Scan or search for a device using the search field or QR scanner
  2. The device information appears at the top
  3. Position the crosshair on the floor plan where the device is located
  4. Tap Install to confirm the position
  5. The device is now associated with that location

Installation Tips

  • Zoom in for precise positioning
  • The crosshair shows exact meter coordinates
  • You can reposition devices after installation (see Installation Location)
  • Use QR code scanning for faster installation workflow
  • Physical device placement should match the digital position

item.title: Keywords Management
item.description:
For Viewers & Installers

Keywords are tags that categorize devices for logical organization and filtering.

Browsing Devices by Keywords

Roles: Viewer, Installer, Designer, Manager

From the sidebar, tap By keywords (under Devices section) to browse devices organized by keywords.

  1. View the alphabetical list of all keywords
  2. Use the filter field to find specific keywords
  3. Tap a keyword to see associated devices

Editing Keywords

Roles: Installer, Designer, Manager

From the sidebar, tap Edit keywords to manage the keyword list.

item.title: Viewing Devices on Map
item.description:
For Viewers & Installers

Roles: Viewer, Installer, Designer, Manager

The global map view shows all installed devices with geographic coordinates.

Accessing the Map

From the sidebar, tap On map under the Inventory section.

Map Features

  • Device Markers: Devices appear as pins on the map
  • Clustering: Devices in close proximity are grouped together
  • Zoom: Pinch to zoom in/out
  • Pan: Drag to move around the map

Interacting with Devices

  • Tap a marker to see device information
  • Tap the info popup to open the device detail view

Understanding Map Coverage

Note: Only devices with global coordinates (latitude/longitude) appear on the map. Devices installed on floor plans without geo-referenced coordinates won’t be visible here.

item.title: Inventory by Zones
item.description:
For Viewers & Installers

Roles: Viewer, Installer, Designer, Manager

Browse devices organized by their physical location in the space hierarchy.

Accessing Zones Inventory

From the sidebar, tap By zones under the Inventory section.

Space Hierarchy

The hierarchy follows this structure:

Organization
└── Site (Location)
 └── Building
 └── Floor
 └── Zone
 └── Devices

Navigating the Hierarchy

  1. Select a Site from the list
  2. Select a Building within the site
  3. Select a Floor within the building
  4. Select a Zone to see its devices
  5. Tap a Device to view details

Table View Features

  • Device count: Each level shows the number of contained devices
  • Pull to refresh: Update the device list
  • Search/Filter: Filter devices within a zone

Understanding the Structure

Sites (Locations)

The top level of the hierarchy representing physical locations or campuses.

item.title: Device Alerts
item.description:
For Viewers & Installers

Roles: Viewer, Installer, Designer, Manager

Monitor device health alerts including battery warnings and connectivity issues.

Accessing Device Alerts

From the sidebar, tap Device alerts under the Devices section.

Alert Types

Battery Voltage Warnings

The system monitors battery voltage for supported device types:

Device Model Warning Threshold
XSATS1, TSATS1 Less than 2.26V
Viking Classic/Slim/Tough Less than 2.1V
XXRB01, TSRB01 Less than 3.2V

Devices with battery voltage below these thresholds are flagged for battery replacement.

item.title: Configuration Log
item.description:
For Viewers & Installers

Roles: Viewer, Installer, Designer, Manager

View the history of device configuration changes.

Accessing Configuration Log

From the sidebar, tap Configuration log under the Devices section.

Log Information

The log shows a chronological list of all device configuration changes with:

  • Timestamp: When the configuration was changed
  • Device: Which device was configured (with device name/ID)
  • Change type: What was modified
  • User: Who made the change (username/email)
  • Details: Specific configuration values changed

Filtering the Log

By Date Range

  1. Tap the date filter
  2. Select Start date
  3. Select End date
  4. Apply filter

By Device

  1. Use the search field
  2. Enter device name or ID
  3. Log filters to show only that device’s changes
